description.zh-CN: Jsonita 的项目级开放 backlog。

rows.zh-CN: 崩溃恢复 / 数据完整性 spec 增补：SQLite、settings.json、window.json 损坏时的检测、恢复、用户提示与日志策略还未形成完整契约。
rows.en: Crash recovery / data integrity spec update: corrupted SQLite, settings.json, and window.json recovery behavior still needs a complete contract.

rows.zh-CN: 补齐 spec/10_storage.html 与 spec/15_logging.html；完成条件是损坏检测、恢复策略、用户提示、日志边界和验证方式都有明确表述。
rows.en: Update spec/10_storage.html and spec/15_logging.html; done when detection, recovery, user messaging, log boundaries, and validation are explicit.

rows.zh-CN: CAST JSON-first 迁移：plan/*.html 与 spec/*.html 仍是 legacy HTML 发布页，尚未逐页迁移为 CAST JSON 源。
rows.en: CAST JSON-first migration: plan/*.html and spec/*.html are still legacy HTML published pages and have not been migrated page by page into CAST JSON sources.

rows.zh-CN: 按页面逐一迁移，先从体量小的 plan/00 或 spec/10 开始；完成条件是每个发布页都有 JSON 源、渲染产物和 freshness check。
rows.en: Migrate page by page, starting with a smaller page such as plan/00 or spec/10; done when each published page has a JSON source, rendered artifact, and freshness check.

rows.zh-CN: legacy Mermaid 发布面：现有 plan/spec HTML 中的图需要保持内联 SVG，不允许回退到运行时 CDN 或 raw Mermaid 文本。
rows.en: Legacy Mermaid published surface: diagrams in current plan/spec HTML must stay inline SVG and must not regress to runtime CDN or raw Mermaid text.

rows.zh-CN: 每次修改图表后运行 pnpm docs:render-mermaid 与 pnpm docs:check；完成条件是 strict HTML 检查不再发现 raw Mermaid/CDN。
rows.en: After diagram edits, run pnpm docs:render-mermaid and pnpm docs:check; done when strict HTML checks find no raw Mermaid/CDN.

rows.zh-CN: macOS 原生 vibrancy 跟随主题验收：需要在真实 macOS 环境确认 light/dark/system 下 NSVisualEffectView 材质和 appearance 同步。
rows.en: macOS native vibrancy theme verification: confirm in a real macOS environment that NSVisualEffectView material and appearance sync under light/dark/system.

rows.zh-CN: 运行 cargo build / pnpm tauri dev，手动验证 light→system、dark OS fresh launch、运行中 OS 主题变化；如 dark 仍发灰，再比较 HudWindow 与 UnderWindowBackground。
rows.en: Run cargo build / pnpm tauri dev and manually verify light-to-system, dark OS fresh launch, and runtime OS theme changes; compare HudWindow with UnderWindowBackground if dark still looks gray.

rows.zh-CN: 为 CAST 文档脚本补 CI：本地已有 docs:render、docs:check、docs:render-mermaid，CI 尚未强制执行。
rows.en: Add CI coverage for CAST documentation scripts: local docs:render, docs:check, and docs:render-mermaid exist but CI does not enforce them yet.

rows.zh-CN: 把 docs:check 接入 GitHub Actions 或发布前脚本；完成条件是文档 freshness、homepage contract 和 Mermaid/CDN 检查自动失败。
rows.en: Wire docs:check into GitHub Actions or release preflight; done when freshness, homepage contract, and Mermaid/CDN checks fail automatically.

rows.zh-CN: 安全合规审计清单：面向 macOS App Store、企业部署或更大范围分发时才需要。v1 小范围内测不阻塞。
rows.en: Security/compliance audit checklist: needed for macOS App Store, enterprise deployment, or broader distribution. It does not block v1 small beta testing.

rows.zh-CN: 触发条件出现后补充 spec/12_packaging.html 与 plan/04_nfr.html；完成条件是权限、隐私、签名、公证和数据保留材料清单明确。
rows.en: When triggered, update spec/12_packaging.html and plan/04_nfr.html; done when permissions, privacy, signing, notarization, and data-retention materials are explicit.
